name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based PDF reader and editor built in Rust and WebAssembly: read, search, organize, combine, split, annotate, fill forms, protect and OCR PDFs.

alerts.message: Documents are not stored on the server: the web app runs in the browser and starts fresh on every visit. Save your PDFs to your own device before closing the tab.
The upstream project publishes no container image; this one is built by a community maintainer from the official releases.
